name: Kirioka Taiki
source:
The protagonist of this work. Taiki lives in the abandoned dormitory of Kirigaoka Gakuin with his sister-in-law [url=/c57823]Chitose[/url], and has lived a carefree life after graduating from high school. He has a lethargic and reluctant personality, he lost the memory of his real parents when he was young. He was later taken in by the Kirioka clan as his adoptive family.

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
